class.name: OcgGceMakerotation2d
class.brief_description: Implements an elementary construction algorithm for a rotation in 2D space. The result is a gp_Trsf2d transformation. A MakeRotation2d object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of the transformation, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the result.
